verdict.rationale: Bun's homepage publishes a measured install-time comparison (bun v1.4 at 0.21s vs npm v12.0.2 at 4.45s), and the docs repeat headline multipliers ("up to 25x faster", "up to 30x faster"). That is a vendor-published measured number, but there is only one thin data point with no visible methodology, and the two multiplier claims are inconsistent with each other. missing for 10: documented benchmark methodology (project fixture, cold vs warm cache, hardware), a reproducible benchmark harness or repo, comparisons against yarn/pnpm, and independent or hands-on measurements corroborating the numbers.
